header.label: research
header.title: Variational Tensor Neural Networks: A Critical Analysis
header.lede: A close reading of a 2024 paper that trains tensor-network layers with an algorithm from quantum physics. Its real contribution is not the scalability its abstract claims, but a quantitative window on what a trained network has learned.

decisions.title: Old ingredients
decisions.formula: M = U S V^\dagger = L R,\qquad L = U\sqrt{S},\quad R = \sqrt{S}\,V^\dagger
decisions.caption: A weight matrix split by SVD; keeping the χ largest singular values λᵢ in S sets the bond dimension, the compression and the correlations allowed between tensors.

decisions.title: The move that matters: a two-site update
decisions.caption: Two neighbouring tensors are contracted into a bond tensor B, updated by a local gradient step, then split again by SVD: the singular values are exposed at every step of training.

decisions.title: A number that reads the data
decisions.caption: Entanglement entropy at a bond. Gaussian blobs: S ≈ 0 at 99 % accuracy. Three spirals: S settles around 0.7–0.8 at about 95 %.

decisions.title: MNIST is a proof of concept
decisions.caption: The TNN wins only the single-epoch comparison; its DMRG training time per epoch grows exponentially with the number of MPO tensors, against about ten seconds per epoch for the dense baseline.
